intro: Northpass Tower is a ruined Lordaeron scout tower situated in the northern reaches of the Eastern Plaguelands along the road to Quel'Thalas. Shattered during the Third War, it still overlooks the northern road toward the elven lands.

p: Built by the Kingdom of Lordaeron to guard the vital thoroughfare leading north into Quel'Thalas, Northpass Tower was reduced to a broken shell during the Scourge invasion. Despite its shattered stonework, the tower's elevated position retains immense tactical value, overlooking the blight-choked frontier between Stratholme's blighted outskirts and the distant elven lands.
No garrison mans the tower today. Its broken walls stand along a road now haunted by the Scourge, a reminder of the watch Lordaeron once kept over the route to Quel'Thalas.
